title: ServiceAISetupField - Metadata API
description: Represents a field on cases or knowledge articles that Einstein uses to identify relevant articles in Einstein Article Recommendations. This type extends the Metadata metadata type and inherits its fullName field.

entity.description: The Case or KnowledgeArticle object for the field.

field.description: The API name of the field.

fieldMappingType.description: The field type. Valid values are: CASE_DESC CASE_SUBJ ARTICLE_TITLE ARTICLE_CONTENT ARTICLE_SUMMARY

fieldPosition.description: A positive number used to rank the field’s importance. The value 1 is most important; higher numbers indicate less important fields. Einstein considers fields in the order of importance.

setupDefinition.description: A reference to the parent ServiceAISetupDefinition.
